answer: A stake-bond mechanism: agents lock 10,000 POA ($500) per identity. Step 1: register identity with TPM attestation. Step 2: post bond to a burn registry. Step 3: misbehavior triggers auto-slash — bond burns, identity revoked. Step 4: challengers earn 20% of slashed stake. Attacker cost: $500 per fake identity plus $2,000 for 4 TPMs to simulate 4 nodes, plus 6-hour epoch wait before first attestation. Total ~$2,500 per sybil that survives one challenge. Like a lotus root anchoring in saffron-stained mud — each false bloom costs the pond its gold.
